title: Scene Mesh Loading Flicker
description: Scene play flickers infinitely between Loading meshes and rendered GLBs. Fix GLTF pool release clearing cache on chunk unmount and stabilize chunk visibility.
summary: Fixed infinite scene loading flicker: chunk culling was unmounting SceneObject trees, sceneGltfPoolRelease called useGLTF.clear and invalidated the drei cache, and the outer Suspense showed Loading meshes again. Stopped auto-clearing GLTF cache on pool release (added sceneGltfPoolClear for explicit teardown), and keep chunk groups mounted with visible toggled instead of conditional unmount. Added e2e regression test.
